EN:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh yeah!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Now I remember.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Mmm.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I should loan you stuff more

ES:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}}¡Ah, sí!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Ahora lo recuerdo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Mmm...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Debería prestarte cosas

{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh, è vero!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Ora mi ricordo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Dovrei prestarti le mie cose
